_comment: Reference config for the next step (Kafka -> Elasticsearch). Requires the Confluent Elasticsearch Sink connector jar in the Connect image's plugin path — it is NOT bundled in docker-compose.audit.yml's debezium/connect image. See deploy/audit/README.md 'Wiring the Elasticsearch sink' for how to add it. Until then, use the sample consumer in the README to index documents, or watch the topic with kcat.
